description: This file defines a builder class for constructing immutable SearchQuery instances with a fluent API. It includes methods to set sorting options, limits, and filters, and contains an internal immutable class representing the constructed SearchQuery.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchQueryBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class with a fluent API for creating immutable SearchQuery objects. It manages search filters, sort options, and limit options.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchQuery
classes.description: An internal immutable class implementing the SearchQuery interface, representing a fully built search query with optional sorting and limits.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with the provided search filter.

methods.name: sortAsc
methods.description: Adds a sorting option in ascending order for the specified property path.

methods.name: sortDesc
methods.description: Adds a sorting option in descending order for the specified property path.

methods.name: removeSortOptionFor
methods.description: Removes any existing sort option for the given property path.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets a limit with offset and count on the search query, with validation.

methods.name: removeLimitation
methods.description: Removes any limit options from the search query.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable SearchQuery object based on the current state.
